description: This file contains functions and types related to handling post-compaction side effects and hooks in an agent system, including memory synchronization, hook execution, and token estimation.

classes.name: CompactionHookRunner
classes.description: Interface for executing hooks before and after data compaction processes.

methods.name: resolvePostCompactionIndexSyncMode
methods.description: Determines the synchronization mode ('off', 'async', 'await') based on configuration.

methods.name: runPostCompactionSessionMemorySync
methods.description: Synchronizes session memory after compaction if configured to do so.

methods.name: syncPostCompactionSessionMemory
methods.description: Controls the synchronization process based on the specified mode.

methods.name: runPostCompactionSideEffects
methods.description: Executes side effects after post-compaction, including transcript update and memory sync.

methods.name: asCompactionHookRunner
methods.description: Wraps a global hook runner into a local compaction hook runner interface.

methods.name: estimateTokenCountSafe
methods.description: Safely estimates token count for a list of messages, catching errors.

methods.name: buildBeforeCompactionHookMetrics
methods.description: Builds metrics related to messages and tokens before compaction.

methods.name: runBeforeCompactionHooks
methods.description: Executes hooks before data compaction, including internal event and optional custom hook.

methods.name: estimateTokensAfterCompaction
methods.description: Estimates token count after compaction, with sanity checks.

methods.name: runAfterCompactionHooks
methods.description: Executes hooks after data compaction, including internal event and optional custom hook.
